scripts.dev: npm run build -w @heirloom/learner && concurrently -n learner,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @heirloom/learner" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @heirloom/learner && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @heirloom/learner && npm run typecheck -w @heirloom/learner && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.lint: biome lint && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-deps.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
